written: 2026-10-03 ~02:45 ET, after the in-sample analysis and BEFORE any out-of-sample evaluation
headline: PRIMARY
headline_note: The pre-registered specification (HYPOTHESIS.md, config/strategy.json v1.0) is the headline and is reported whatever its out-of-sample result. In-sample it failed its own kill condition (FF5+UMD alpha t = 0.09 < 1).

post_hoc_candidates.name: voice_only
post_hoc_candidates.why: In-sample the voice block was the only modality with a positive Sharpe (0.22). Theory points the same way: vocal cues are the most diagnostic deception channel for observers (Bond & DePaulo 2006: 63% audio vs 52% video) and executive vocal affect predicts outcomes (Mayew & Venkatachalam 2012). Selected after seeing in-sample results, so it is labeled post-hoc and its in-sample Sharpe is deflated over every logged trial.

post_hoc_candidates.name: hedge_QQQ
post_hoc_candidates.why: Pre-declared robustness variant. Most of the universe is large-cap tech, so a Nasdaq-100 hedge removes sector noise that the SPY hedge leaves in (in-sample Sharpe 0.22 vs 0.07). Selected after seeing in-sample results; labeled post-hoc.

rules: Each strategy is evaluated on 2024-10-01..2026-09-30 exactly once, with the same code and costs as in-sample.
No candidate is added, dropped or modified after the out-of-sample run; results/oos_log.md records the run.
The note reports all three out-of-sample results side by side, with the primary as the headline.
